messages.content:
Below is a conversation between two people: Joanna and Nate. The conversation takes place over multiple days and the date of each conversation is wriiten at the beginning of the conversation.


DATE: 7:31 pm on 21 January, 2022
CONVERSATION:
Nate said, "Hey Joanna! Long time no see! What's up? Anything fun going on?"

Joanna said, "Hey Nate! Long time no see! I've been working on a project lately - it's been pretty cool. What about you - any fun projects or hobbies?"

Nate said, "Hey Joanna! That's cool! I won my first video game tournament last week - so exciting!"

Joanna said, "Wow Nate! Congrats on winning! Tell me more - what game was it?"

Nate said, "Thanks! it's a team shooter game."

Joanna said, "Wow, great job! What was is called?"

Nate said, "The game was called Counter-Strike: Global Offensive, and me and my team had a blast to the very end!"

Joanna said, "Cool, Nate! Sounds like a fun experience, even if I'm not into games."

Nate said, "It was! How about you? Do you have any hobbies you love?"

Joanna said, "Yeah! Besides writing, I also enjoy reading, watching movies, and exploring nature. Anything else you enjoy doing, Nate?"

Nate said, "Playing video games and watching movies are my main hobbies."

Joanna said, "Cool, Nate! So we both have similar interests. What type of movies do you like best?"

Nate said, "I love action and sci-fi movies, the effects are so cool! What about you, what's your favorite genre?"

Joanna said, "I'm all about dramas and romcoms. I love getting immersed in the feelings and plots."

Nate said, "Wow, movies can be so powerful! Do you have any recommendations for me?"

Joanna said, "Yeah, totally! Have you seen this romantic drama that's all about memory and relationships? It's such a good one."
 and shared a photo of a poster of a man and a woman sitting on a bench.
Nate said, "Oh cool! I might check that one out some time soon! I do love watching classics."

Joanna said, "Yep, that movie is awesome. I first watched it around 3 years ago. I even went out and got a physical copy!"
 and shared a photo of a dvd on a table with a blurry background.
Nate said, "Sounds cool! Have you seen it a lot? sounds like you know the movie well!"

Joanna said, "A few times. It's one of my favorites! I really like the idea and the acting."

Nate said, "Cool! I'll definitely check it out. Thanks for the recommendation!"

Joanna said, "No problem, Nate! Let me know if you like it!"


DATE: 2:01 pm on 23 January, 2022
CONVERSATION:
Joanna said, "Hey Nate! Haven't talked in a few days. Crazy things happened to me!"

Nate said, "Hi Joanna! Long time no see! What's been going on? You sound excited!"

Joanna said, "Woo! I finally finished my first full screenplay and printed it last Friday. I've been working on for a while, such a relief to have it all done!"
 and shared a photography of a book with a page of text on it.
Nate said, "Wow, that sounds awesome! What's it about? Glad it's all down!"

Joanna said, "Thanks, Nate! It's a mix of drama and romance!"

Nate said, "Wow, that's amazing! How do you feel now that it's finished? Do you have any new plans for it?"

Joanna said, "Woohoo, Nate! I'm feeling a rollercoaster of emotions - relief, excitement, some anxiety - over finishing this project. Now I'm gonna submit it to some film festivals and (hopefully) get producers and directors to check it out. Here's hoping!"

Nate said, "Congrats, Joanna! That sounds like a wild experience. Rock on and I hope they love it!"

Joanna said, "Thanks Nate! A mix of emotions for sure. Hopefully, it leads to positive feedback and new opportunities."

Nate said, "Yeah, for sure. Hoping for the best! I like having some of these little ones around to keep me calm when things are super important and I'm nervous."
 and shared a photography of a turtle and a turtleling sitting on a rock.
Joanna said, "Awww! How long have you had them?"

Nate said, "I've had them for 3 years now and they bring me tons of joy!"

Joanna said, 

[... 83,923 characters omitted ...]

na said, "Wow, what made you get a third?"

Nate said, "Turtles really bring me joy and peace. They have such an effect on us - best buddies ever! I saw another at a pet store and just hade to get him. The tank is big enough now for three, so I figured why not!"
 and shared a photo of a turtle swimming in a tank with a metal bar.
Joanna said, "Wow! It's always a shock where life will take us next! I bet just last week you would have never thought you would be getting a third turtle this year!"

Nate said, "You got that right, but I'm very happy with the descision and wouldn't have it any other way."

Joanna said, "Can I come over sometime and watch you play with them? From a distance I mean, since I'm allergic."

Nate said, "Definitely! I'd love to have you over again. Maybe we can watch one of your movies together or go to the park!"

Joanna said, "For sure! I'd love to do either of those things with you!"

Nate said, "Sounds good. Well I'll make sure I give the turtles a bath before you get here so they're ready to play."

Joanna said, "Alright, see you tomorrow!"

Nate said, "Bye Joanna!"


DATE: 12:06 am on 11 November, 2022
CONVERSATION:
Joanna said, "Nate, can you believe it? I'm finally filming my own movie from the road-trip script!"
 and shared a photo of a person holding a clap board with a dog sleeping in a dog bed.
Nate said, "Congrats, Joanna! Not surprised at all that your hard work paid off. Must feel awesome to see your script come alive in a movie! Pretty cool when something you love brings success, right? Tell me more about your movie!"
 and shared a photo of a trophy and a game controller on a table.
Joanna said, "Woohoo, thanks Nate! It's pretty wild to see it come alive. Every day on set is awesome and full of potential. Being able to show my vision is awesome."

Nate said, "I think so too! What's been the coolest moment on set?"
 and shared a photo of a fish tank with a fish inside of it.
Joanna said, "One of the actors came up to me and told me how much she liked my script! I was so excited when that happened - it gave me chills!"

Nate said, "Wow Joanna, that must have been so exciting! It's incredible when you get those moments of joy. Anyway, I took my turtles to the beach in Tampa yesterday! They always bring me peace in the craziness of life."
 and shared a photo of a turtle in a sink with a reflection of its head.
Joanna said, "Woah, that's awesome, Nate! You must really enjoy having them around - they're so cool! What do you love most about having them?"

Nate said, "Your completely right! I really love having them around. They're so cool and they make me feel calm. Plus, they don't require much looking after, which is great. I love seeing them soaking in the sun like this."
 and shared a photo of a turtle sitting on a log in a pond.
Joanna said, "That's awesome, Nate! They look so serene and happy. It's great to have something like that."

Nate said, "Yeah, turtles are like zen masters! They always remind me to slow down and appreciate the small things in life. I'm loving experimenting with flavors right now. Here are some colorful bowls of coconut milk ice cream that I made."
 and shared a photography of a bowl of ice cream with a spoon in it.
Joanna said, "Hey Nate, that looks really yummy! The colors and mix-ins give it a nice kick."

Nate said, "Nice! I'm glad you like it too. This recipe really jazzes it up. Wanna give it a try?"

Joanna said, "Definitely, Nate! That ice cream looks mouthwatering. Thanks so much for offering!"

Nate said, "No worries, Joanna. Hope you enjoy it!"

Joanna said, "Yea, no worries! It was great catching up. Take it easy!"




Based on the above conversations, write a short answer for the following question in a few words. Do not write complete and lengthy sentences. Answer with exact words from the conversations whenever possible.

Question: What major achievement did Joanna accomplish in January 2022? Use DATE of CONVERSATION to answer with an approximate date.
